notes.title: Update 1.03 + Looking for Linux and Mac testers
notes.notes:
Hi guys. Update 1.03 is here !

Fixes
- Fixed small bug in the menu that appeared after completing a challenge mode

Features
In-game timer for story levels, requested by numerous speedrunners!
- You can turn it on/off by pressing 'T' / 'Gamepad Y'
- This shortcut is presented to new players in stage 2
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=873533109
Looking for Linux and Mac testers
Let me know if you would like to help!  ːsteamhappyː
It would be great if you already played the game on windows so you know how it should behave, but make sure to contact me even if you didn`t ! :)

Have a nice day!
- Ondrej

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
New Features
Fast Restart - Just press 'R' or 'Gamepad X' for immediate restart in story levels. Great for speedrunners who want to improve their leaderboard position.
Cast model - Some people wondered why did your cast disappear after stage 6, Now it can be seen at the beginning of stage 7, as our climber has super healing abilities and he just doesn`t need it anymore! ːsteamhappyː
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/c1a7c5d8530d17b60dfba9042d990be0346f3460.png

Fixes/Adjustments
- fixed typo in main menu
- fixed collision zone of electric cable in story stage 3
- made wind in story stage 8 weaker 
- in story stage 6 you could grab the moving bed through railing
(character usualy exploded as it was squished afterwards)

Make sure to make a post in our Discussion Forum if you find a bug or if you got an awesome idea how to make City Climber a better game!
Thanks! :)

notes.title: Release date announced!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

We finally have a release date!  ːsteamhappyː
You will be able to get City Climber on 24th of February for 6.99 $.

I`ve made loads of improvements durning the last months. Visuals and design of the game are better than ever and I`m currently finishing up my work on various physic-based challenges.

This picture is from a challenge mode, where your task is to roll down the stairs. (in this case - while driving a small tractor)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26551872/d12f648e084d2f181dbf46ca261c687e1b96fa2a.png

I will be putting together a more detailed article about my progress in the next couple of days!

You can check out my   Twitter  in the meantime. 
There are a lot of interesting pictures and videos from the game.

Feel free to ask questions in the comment section below, or in the forums!
Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Dev Log & Postponed release
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

I know these are pretty sad news. But I had to postpone the release date of City Climber to Q1 of 2017 (early 2017). 

Main reason for this decision, is that there are massive sales on Steam during end of the year, and small games like City Climber just get lost in all the discounted titles. I`m really sorry about the delay but I just cannot compete againts discounted AAA games during their biggest sales. I hope that you will understand.

Otherwise, development is going pretty good and game is really shaping up! 
Check out the new videos in the latest article on IndieDB:
http://www.indiedb.com/games/city-climber/news/city-climber-dev-log-18

See you next week! ːsteamhappyː
